subject: ClearEats pilot — results brief & one-line endorsement request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@cleareats.com>, Jordan Lyle <jordan.lyle@cleareats.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearEats pilot — results brief & one-line endorsement request

Hi Sara / Jordan —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last month. Quick recap from our side (attached is the short dashboard and raw logs):

• Latency: average request latency dropped from ~210 ms (baseline) to ~85 ms during production-mode runs — ~3.4x improvement.
• Cost: estimated inference cost per 1k tokens decreased by ~42% after batching + KV-cache tuning.
• Throughput: sustained throughput improved ~2.1x in our dedicated config vs baseline.
• Quality: NER F1 rose from 86.7 to 90.2 on your labeled eval set (subset provided).

We were hoping to ask for two small favors that would help our case studies / GTM:
1) A one-line endorsement we can use in a short outcomes blurb (example: “Redwood cut inference latency by X and reduced costs by Y during our pilot.”) — attribution to ClearEats + job title is fine.
2) A 10–15 minute sync (recording OK) to capture one or two concrete details (optional) that marketing can use.

If that works, does next Tuesday (8/22) or Wednesday (8/23) morning PT work for a quick call?

Attachments: pilot-kpi-dashboard.pdf, deployment-logs.csv

Thanks — really excited by the performance lift you saw.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Boyd <sara.boyd@cleareats.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lyle <jordan.lyle@cleareats.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearEats pilot — results brief & one-line endorsement request

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachments — the dashboard looks great. The latency and cost improvements you shared match what our ops team measured during the window you used.

You have permission to use a short one-liner from us. Please feel free to use the following (attributed to me, Head of Data at ClearEats):

“During our Redwood pilot, we saw >3x latency improvement and roughly 40% lower inference cost, enabling faster customer responses without compromising accuracy.”

I’m happy to do a 10–15 minute call next week to give context — 8/23 at 10:00 AM PT works for me.

I’ve attached our company logo in case you need it for the brief.

Best,
Sara Boyd
Head of Data, ClearEats
sara.boyd@cleareats.com
Attachment: cleareats_logo.png
